question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for the words in italics:

*The scholar focused on the scientific study of ancient civilizations.*
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Archaeology)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Archaeology"** refers to the scientific study of human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of artifacts and other physical remains. (पुरातत्व विज्ञान)

 
 
• **Example:** The archaeologist discovered ancient pottery and tools while excavating the site.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the scholar is focused on studying ancient civilizations, which aligns with the definition of Archaeology.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Archaeology)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sociology** (समाजशास्त्र): The study of the development, structure, and functioning of human society.

 
 
• **Example:** Sociology examines how individuals interact within groups and societies.
 
 
 
• **Anthropology** (मानव विज्ञान): The study of human societies and cultures and their development.
 
 
• **Example:** Anthropology helps us understand cultural differences and similarities among people.
 
 
 
• **Ethnography** (जातिवृत्त): The systematic study of people and cultures from an observational and participatory perspective.
 
 
• **Example:** The ethnography project focused on the unique traditions of a remote community.
 
 

30:T9a1,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
